messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "follow a cholesterol-lowering diet plan"
set: ["follow a cholesterol-lowering diet plan", "follow the diet plan created for you by your doctor or nutrition counselor", "doctor may start on cholesterol-lowering diet before giving drug", "follow special diet to help prevent kidney stones", "your treatment may include a special diet", "treatment may include diet", "reduce salt in diet", "follow your doctor's instructions", "plan to stay somewhere you can relax and reach a bathroom", "follow dosage escalation schedule", "always follow doctor's instructions", "follow doctor's instructions about using potassium supplements or getting enough salt and potassium in your diet", "tell doctor if changed diet", "always follow your doctor's directions when giving to a child", "used in addition to a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity", "tell doctor if plan to become pregnant"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
